name: Madame Ozymandia's survey of Prosperity
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. Divined A7, on Form 12-C. Lodged with Sump at A9. Errata 66 ruling A: shown to the character at C5 and kept; never consumed.

LOOK_AT.say: Madame Ozymandia's survey of Prosperity, on Form 12-C, in purple ink. It begins at the stake, thereabouts, and goes on with feeling.
repeat: 'Thence along the line the rod preferred.' It is the first boundary I have seen with a preference.
It is nonsense on the correct form. I am told that is the stronger of the two.

LISTEN_TO.say: Paper. It smells of incense and two dollars.
repeat: Nothing. It has said what the rod told it to, and it has no further instructions.
